This file has a lot of unrelated whitespace changes, please restore them (please do not hide until you've actually completed)

There's a line left, line 48

```suggestion

PackedStringArray ResourceLoader::get_cached_paths() {
```
For all you added, please leave an empty line between methods in the `cpp` files

```suggestion
		FILTER_TARGET_TYPE_HINT,
```
Redundant

```suggestion
		FILTER_TARGET_RESOURCE_CLASS,
```
To ease expansion

```suggestion
		FILTER_COMP_EQUALS,
```
`auto` is [not allowed](https://contributing.godotengine.org/en/latest/engine/guidelines/cpp_usage_guidelines.html#auto-keyword), for both

```suggestion
			Ref<Resource> res = res_ptr;
```
Redundant, for both
Please write comments in English

```suggestion
		Dictionary paths_types_dict;
```
Redundant

```suggestion
}

```
All here as well
Also all these `auto`
Lambdas are [not allowed](https://contributing.godotengine.org/en/latest/engine/guidelines/cpp_usage_guidelines.html#lambdas) generally unless unavoidable, I think other options should be considered

```suggestion
		FILTER_TARGET_TYPE_HINT,
```

```suggestion
		FILTER_TARGET_RESOURCE_CLASS,
```

```suggestion
		FILTER_COMP_EQUALS,
```

+			<description>

+			<param index="2" name="value" type="String" />
+			<description>
+				Returns all cached resource paths that match a single filter condition as [PackedStringArray]
+				The [param target] selects which attribute is checked, [param comparator] defines how it is compared to
+				[param value].
+				Allowed [param target]: FILTER_TARGET_TYPE_HINT, FILTER_TARGET_PATH, FILTER_TARGET_FILE_NAME, FILTER_TARGET_FILE_EXTENSION, FILTER_TARGET_BASE_DIR, FILTER_TARGET_RESOURCE_NAME, FILTER_TARGET_RESOURCE_PATH, FILTER_TARGET_RESOURCE_CLASS.
+				Allowed [param comparator]: FILTER_COMP_EQUALS, FILTER_COMP_NOT_EQUAL, FILTER_COMP_BEGINS_WITH,	FILTER_COMP_ENDS_WITH, FILTER_COMP_CONTAINS.
+				[b]Examples (GDScript)[/b]
+				All Image resources (type hint)
+				[codeblock]
+				var img_paths = ResourceLoader.get_cached_paths_by_filter(
+				ResourceLoader.FILTER_TARGET_TYPE_HINT,
+				ResourceLoader.FILTER_COMP_EQUALS,
+				"Image"
+				)
body:
```suggestion
				var img_paths = ResourceLoader.get_cached_paths_by_filter(
						ResourceLoader.FILTER_TARGET_TYPE_HINT,
						ResourceLoader.FILTER_COMP_EQUALS,
						"Image")
```
The continuation of the method should be indented twice, per the [style guide](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/tutorials/scripting/gdscript/gdscript_styleguide.html#indentation), for all
